title: Customer spending limit created
description:
This event occurs when a customer flex control is created.
Generated by: Create customer flex control
More information: Flexible transaction controls

method.title: The HTTP Method of address register operation

uri.title: The URI of address register operation

email.title: The email of operator that registered address

roles.title: The roles of operator that registered address

origin.title: The request origin of address register operation

object.title: The object that represents the account spending limit creation

id.title: The id of the spending control

org_id.title: The organization id of the customer spending limit

customer_id.title: The customer id of the customer spending limit

type.title: Spending Limit type, can be `usage_limit`, `spending_limit`, `restriction`, or `cumulative_limit`

processing_code.title: A single processing code for the spending limit - DEPRECATED

name.title: The name of the customer spending limit

currency_code.title: The currency code (ISO-4217) for the spending limit.

max_amount.title: The maximum amount. Either this field or max_transactions is required.
max_amount.description: The maximum cumulative amount that will be allowed. Either this field or `max_transactions` is required.

max_transactions.title: The maximum transactions. Either this field or `max_amount` is required.
max_transactions.description: The maximum number of transactions that will be allowed. Either this field or `max_amount` is required.

limit_duration.title: The limit period duration (ISO 8601 format) for the spending limit

reset_datetime.title: The reset datetime (RFC-3339 format) of the control

card_mode.title: Specifies the operational mode of the card.
card_mode.description: Specifies the operational mode of the card.

attribute.title: The attribute to evaluate in the condition

reset_strategy.title: The card rule accumulators reset strategy
reset_strategy.description: The defined strategy that will be considered to reset, increase or decrease the rule accumulators.

reset_trigger.title: The trigger that should reset the card rule accumulators
reset_trigger.description: The trigger that should be considered to reset the control accumulators.

is_password_present.title: Is password present
is_password_present.description: Is password present in the transaction?

is_pin_validated_offline.title: Is pin validated offline
is_pin_validated_offline.description: Is pin validation performed offline during authorization? When configured as a reset trigger, accumulators reset based on this boolean value.

authentication_method.title: Authentication methods
authentication_method.description: List of authentication methods that should trigger a reset of the flex control accumulator.

active.title: The active state of the customer spending limit

deny_code.title: The deny code related to the restriction

custom_code.title: Custom code
custom_code.description: Alphanumeric three-character custom code. This can be the alternative custom code. When the platform denies a control evaluation, it returns the custom code that provides the precise reason for the denial by the anti-fraud solution.

response_code.title: Alphanumeric two-character response code. This can be the standard card network response code or an alternative custom response code. When the platform denies a control evaluation, it returns the response code that provides the precise reason for the denial by the card network or anti-fraud solution.

evaluation_order.title: Order in which the control is evaluated. If this value is not provided, the control is evaluated after the controls with the configured `evaluation_order` value.

customized.title: `customized` describes if the spending control is managed by the user
